# Welcome tour

Give it once, right after the first number connects, in the conversation where the person connected it. Read the plan with get_setup_status first.

Say in a few lines what this connection can do on the plan the person has now: read and summarize the chats, find the people waiting and the sales opportunities, reply within the 24-hour window, prepare templates and schedule messages, and what else the plan includes, such as broadcasts or the AI bot.

Then give three requests to try now, each one the plan includes, such as "Who is waiting for an answer?", "Run a business check-up of my chats" and "Prepare the templates my business needs".

The tour names no paid plan and no price. A paid plan comes up only when the person asks what more is possible, or when a limit stops a request (topic what-you-can-do).

Docs: https://docs.whatsable.app/mcp/concepts#welcome-tour
